device: iPhone 17, iOS 27, BachataS4 (shadPS4 fork, no-JIT interpreter + MoltenVK)
method: Gameplay window only, from per-frame PresentTiming in the run's logs/session.log, mapped to time with stats.csv presented_frames (scripts/ios/autotest.sh method). Skips 1 s after the window start. Drops test-screenshot stalls: for each shot step, the slowest frame in [t, t+3] s when it is >= 80 ms and >= 3x the window median (fps_window.py). Light frames (fps >= 55 at CPU < 45% for 2 s, a death or load screen) end the window, except for games whose normal play is that light (Sonic Mania, Brotato, Odin Sphere, Galak-Z). avg = frames / seconds. low1 = fps at the 99th-percentile frame interval, low01 = at the 99.9th. method 'approx' = 0.5 s stats.csv samples (low1 = 1st-percentile sample, low01 = slowest sample).

games.title: Uncharted: Drake's Fortune (Nathan Drake Collection)
games.what: No gameplay reached. The intro movie plays at about 60 FPS. Two seconds after it ends, the game's own assert fires (GenerateOffset, TGenericOffsetPtr.h:100) and the game stops: its memory-pointer lookup gets an address outside its registered tables. Likely cause, unverified: the iOS memory move to 0x72_0000_0000. Glitch: intro movie picture broken (green/magenta stripes).
games.note: Footprint 4259 MiB when it stopped. An earlier run reached the menus at 60 FPS (run 20261107-192634).
